tasks.name: 创建博客模型
tasks.description: 创建 BlogPost 模型用于存储博客信息。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 blog_post.py，包含字段: id, title, description, image_url, created_at。

tasks.name: 创建博客API
tasks.description: 创建博客的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 下创建 blog_posts.py，包含创建博客、获取博客列表的接口，并支持上传图片功能。

tasks.name: 实现图片上传功能
tasks.description: 在后端实现图片上传功能，支持将图片存储到服务器或云存储。在 app/utils/ 下创建 image_upload.py，处理图片上传逻辑，并在 blog_posts.py 中集成。

tasks.name: 创建博客前端页面
tasks.description: 创建博客管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 下创建 blog.html，包含博客创建表单（标题、描述、图片上传）和博客列表展示。

tasks.name: 设计博客页面样式
tasks.description: 为博客页面设计明亮且视觉吸引力强的样式。在 static/css/ 下创建 blog.css，确保图片居中显示，整体设计简洁美观。

T1.implementation_approach: Define a database model with fields like title, content, author, created_at, and updated_at.
T1.notes: Ensure proper indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on the blog model.
T2.notes: Use authentication and validation for secure data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Integrate a file storage service and create an endpoint to handle image uploads and storage.
T3.notes: Validate file types and size to prevent misuse.

T4.implementation_approach: Build a responsive front-end using a framework like React or Vue to display blog posts and allow user interaction.
T4.notes: Ensure compatibility with the API for seamless data fetching.

T5.implementation_approach: Design CSS styles or use a UI library to create a clean and user-friendly layout for the blog pages.
T5.notes: Focus on readability and mobile responsiveness.

file_structure.purpose: Define the BlogPost model with fields for id, title, description, image_url, and created_at.
Implement CRUD API routes for blog posts, including creating and retrieving blog posts.
Handle image upload logic, including saving images to the server or cloud storage.
Create the blog management page with a form for creating blog posts and a list to display them.
Design a bright and visually appealing style for the blog page, ensuring images are centered.

interface_specs.purpose: Define the BlogPost model with fields for id, title, description, image_url, and created_at.
Implement CRUD API routes for blog posts, including creating and retrieving blog posts.
Handle image upload logic, including saving images to the server or cloud storage.

architecture_notes: Web application: Simple Blog with Image Upload

api_specs.description: The frontend communicates with the backend via RESTful API endpoints. The backend returns JSON responses for data retrieval and accepts form-data for blog creation with image uploads.

endpoints.description: Retrieve a list of all blog posts.
Create a new blog post with a title, description, and image upload.

frontend_routes./: Homepage displaying the blog management interface.
